name: repo-secret-sweeper
description: Paste a public GitHub repo URL → get every leaked API key, token, password and committed .env, with a .gitignore patch and a rotation checklist.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
